annotations.title: Market imbalance into the open and close

description: Net dollars to buy or sell into the NYSE opening and closing auctions, calculated by Helious from every NYSE listing's own imbalance print: the whole NYSE market and the S&P 500 names the feed carries, each with its paired volume, the ten largest single names to buy and to sell, and the Helious read of what the lean means for the print. Reads land at 9:28 and 9:29 ET for the open and 3:50, 3:55 and 3:58 PM ET for the close; every read is stored. THIS IS THE TOOL for 'what is the imbalance into the close', 'market on close', 'MOC' or 'how much is there to buy at the bell'. Pass symbol for ONE NYSE-listed name's own prints at every read of a session (side, shares, price, dollars, paired shares); a Nasdaq or NYSE Arca listing answers on_feed false. Market data: numbers follow the connected account.

date.description: With symbol: the session to read, YYYY-MM-DD. Empty is the newest session.

fresh.description: Set true to ask for the live view of this one call, for 5 credits, where the connected account otherwise receives it an hour behind. Accepted and free where the account is already live. No effect without a key.

limit.description: Board only: most reads to list.

since.description: Board only: reads from this ISO instant forward, inside the plan's history window.

symbol.description: One NYSE-listed ticker, like JPM or XOM, for that name's own prints. Empty returns the market board.
